A LITTLE CLOSER LOOK

Food tracking that leaves room for life.

Not every meal comes with a label. Macrova gives you a place to start with the information you have, understand the assumptions, and decide what goes into your journal.

01

Start with what you know

Combine a photo, a voice description and text. Add portions, ingredients or known nutrition when you have them. Manual entry is available when you already know the values.

02

Have the final say

Review the meal description, nutrition, portions and assumptions before saving. Correct the details or ask for a re-evaluation when the AI service is connected. Estimates remain estimates.

03

See your days together

Browse food logs by day, edit a meal or repeat a favourite. Track nutrition and weight over time. Food logs stay on the device, separated by account when accounts are configured.

EARLY ACCESS / ANDROID

Try Macrova.
See what clicks.

Start with one meal.

Use the local explore flow to try manual food entry, then review and save a meal. AI estimation and USDA food or barcode lookup need a reachable backend configured by your test organiser.

The download does not include a public AI server. Firebase account availability depends on configuration. Explore entries can be temporary, and local food logs do not automatically transfer to another phone.

DEVELOPMENT TEST BUILD

Macrova 0.1.0

127.6 MB · Android 7.0+
Published 17 September 2026

Manual food logging works on-device. AI estimation and USDA lookup need a configured, reachable Macrova backend; no public backend is supplied by this download. Account features require Firebase setup. Food logs stay on this device. This development build is intended for local feature testing.
